about: Which checks cover which files. node checks/run.mjs --changed reads this; a file no rule matches runs everything. Smoke entries are pieces of a section title in checks/smoke-shell.mjs (node checks/smoke-parallel.mjs --list shows them); "*" is every section, or every Node check.

model.covers: schema v4, migration, saved-resume files, every recipe byte-identical to before 0.5.1, render hash inputs

store.covers: undo, autosave, folder mirror, backup, checkpoints

paginate.covers: block pagination, Fit on the last page, labels, photo, fields

shell.covers: layout maths (sidebar, rail, page centred, pages side by side, a phone), what a click on each printed text selects, Esc, folder read back

camera.covers: the canvas camera: limits, the magnet, which page is bright, the spring

edit.covers: version numbers, edits, off/keep, sections, 300 random edits

motion.covers: motion rules: tokens, one reduced-motion rule, nothing blocks, the thirteen moments wired

direct.covers: the model behind editing on the page: cut-off, parked edits, lines only on one resume, every printed text as an edit with its base, headings, a language's name, the lock on every function that changes locked content, hiding a block that holds a lock, a reset layout, stale locks, a restore, the record's own edits, the Review list's model (a sub-version copies the source, a new major or claim needs one, Update changes the nearest version and the other resumes see newer wording, headings and names, a line only here becomes a claim, one undo step)

review-model.covers: the Review list's model (and a line's earlier edits: stacked, shown, thrown away, made a version by themselves): no draft or archived version as a parent or pick, a duplicate keeps its held lines, an equal heading is not listed, highlights follow trimmed text, the other resumes an update or a heading change reaches

resumes.covers: autosave, snapshots and sends, frozen text, new, duplicate (a company and a role for a new job), compare, glance, folder

focus.covers: tags, plan = apply, Keep untouched, no job emptied

lang.covers: the ten languages, missing texts, switching, A4 formats

diff.covers: the merge engine on an edited copy of the example

import.covers: every kind of file, JSON Resume round trip, outside edits

savefile.covers: Save to file: format, record id, the ways a file meets this browser, conflict copies

export.covers: the HTML page, plain text, JSON Resume, pre-flight

tokens.covers: theme tokens: forms, refusals, DTCG round trip, contrast

career.covers: the record's model and forms, the checklist folds, job types, the Highlight lens

i18n.covers: every catalogue: keys, placeholders, plurals, markup, the review marker

tokens-built-in.covers: the built-in themes' token files are up to date

themes.covers: the registry of built-in looks (src/themes.js) agrees with the stylesheets, tokens files, ten catalogues and sw.js; scripts/new-theme.mjs on a copy, and each thing missing noticed

design.covers: the look settings: every combination a look offers gives CSS, nothing a look does not offer survives designOf, an empty design is the look's defaults and adds nothing, Small refused on Letter, screen, print and pen differ, the font files exist; the renderer: two-level ranking, the job title beside the name and on one line, Fit's key; what the Design view needs: setDesign writes no key for a default, the Group under the section above switch under a two-level style

native.covers: the native form controls in src/ and index.html against checks/fixtures/native-controls.snapshot.json: a select is in the app's own menu, no date, month, colour or datalist is left, a range and the file input are as listed

parts.covers: the panels' markup unchanged by the shared parts; a claim opened from the page or the checklist is one panel

measurement.covers: page-fill arithmetic, the data-section marker, the probe's coverage

version.covers: package.json, sw.js and CHANGELOG.md name the same version

name.covers: the old product name only in released changelog entries and kept identifiers (CI runs it on _site)

validate-data.covers: the schema guard on the example record

to-jsonresume.covers: the JSON Resume export still works

drink.covers: the app's own tokens in Tea and Coffee, contrast, no colour outside a token block

preload.covers: index.html preloads the modules shell.js imports, and sw.js caches them

csp.covers: Content-Security-Policy: same-origin only, no inline script, no outside fetch

preflight.covers: preflight refuses embedded image metadata and a prototypes/ folder

history-scan.covers: history-scan reads commit messages, authors and committers

private-files.covers: the private check files are found outside the repo, or not at all

prepush.covers: the pre-push hook refuses private content and dry-runs the site for main

agent.covers: the agent workflow on the example: claims, new-resume, refusals, fit, the keyword gap

fit.covers: Fit's invariants on a modelled page

flatpak.covers: the Flatpak files agree: id, version, sandbox, cargo sources, workflow

desktop.covers: the desktop staging copy list is whole

tauri-folder.covers: the Tauri folder object against a fake window.__TAURI__

i18n-review.covers: the translation review sheets: the CSV, and --apply on a temporary copy

runner.covers: this map's globs and plan, the smoke runner's sharding and merge

head-check.covers: place tabs, name card (no Fit, no Saved), name window and seam in ten languages, both drinks, three window sizes and compact: nothing covered, cut or overlapping; Fit and the page bars in Export only

menu-check.covers: the editor menu layout: no footer, Fit in Export and its chip, the page bars at the top of Export, n/m counts, open sections as containers, names that wrap in ten languages

symmetry-check.covers: show/hide as one pill and one wording on the chip, depth row, sections, jobs, lines, items and the photo (round trips), the lock and the pill alike at rest, the chip's tools shown without a hover, the pill on every job head, archived lines in the Outline, the Fit chip staying, the two '+ line' labels; stage 2: an off section kept in its row, the toast's Undo button, the tool beside the padlock (revert, remove a line, remove a skill group) and its lock hold, skill sets cleared and deleted, + group, Delete in the name window, deleting a sent copy, removing a language, and the phone's depth row and menus; a lock asks before deleting the open resume or a sent copy, Reset keeps an off section in place, Fit is held while a screen is open

direct-c-check.covers: UX-6 direct editing round 2, builder C: the plate's tint in hover and selected in the four looks, the look ladder (hover wash per drink, selected x1.5 with a 1px edge, writing, one corner, the timings), the hover zones (a slow path through the gaps shows a big plate only on a heading row), the grip in the plate (dots on approach, a tab where the words leave room, a clear button inside the plate, touch), the plate across a camera ease as writing starts, the drag lighter (1 px edge, wash, small lift) and tighter (12 px give across a one-axis list, 12 px bumper), the hands riding the page frame by frame through a pan and a zoom, the snap drag (lag cap, the pop at halfway) and the free drag behind ?drag=free

direct-d-check.covers: UX-6 direct editing round 2, builder D: the sidebar flash (no animation on an arrow step, one short fade for a new panel kind), the chip, the version pill and movers, the counts, the veil and padlock mark, the header guard

review-check.covers: the Review list's layout in ten languages at 1280x720, 1470x832, 1920x1080 and on a phone: a row of every kind, a long source, the dialog inside the window, nothing cut, overlapping or pushed out

plate-check.covers: the plate, the one selection system (UX-6f 4b): the selection classes the page's frame knows are exactly the plate's and every rule of one takes its outline, shadow, radius and fill from the --plate-* tokens, the tokens reach the frame in Tea and Coffee, light and dark, each class on a line, a group, a job and a section draws what the tokens say, hover, selected (with the ring trail), writing and lifted (with its dashed socket) per level, the preview accent in the plate's shape, the grip as the plate's tab; hover is intent: a fast sweep across blocks or off the page draws no plate, a slow one shows the block it stops on and one at a time (and cross-fades), a stop after a fast sweep shows it within 150 ms, a press, a grip in focus and an arrow step show theirs at once, leaving the page cancels it, into the sidebar and out leaves nothing, under reduced motion too

overlap-check.covers: nothing the app draws over the page overlaps another of its marks or printed text it is not about (UX-6f 4c): the plate and its ring trail, the grip, the "+", the version tools, the depth chip, the socket, the drop line, the rail, the card, the search, preview and missing-text marks, the zoom bar and the photo slot, on a line (first, middle, last of a job), a skill group, a job, a section and a header line, at rest, hovered, mid-glide, selected, written and lifted, in Tea and Coffee, light and dark, at fit and 130%, with motion and reduced, in a narrow window and at phone width, in English and German; the allowed pairs are named in checks/lib/overlap.mjs

review-ui-check.covers: the Review list's behaviour: markup in a resume name is text, use all the newer wording, the select only chooses until Apply, a locked heading is not offered, Ctrl+S/O/P inside the dialog, a failed save keeps it open, newer wording alone does not open it from Save to file

room-check.covers: the sidebar and the layout around the page: hidden share of the body, nothing too wide, the page filling the height

places-check.covers: the three places: the tabs (Library, Editor, Career, aria-current), W E R and not while typing, Esc never changes place (Compare, a selected card, Career's menu, a written line), the address and Back and Forward (ids only), the landing for none, one and two or more resumes and #resume, each place's state, the seam in one spot, Tea's tags swinging in steps and resting, Coffee square and flat

themes-pages.covers: every built-in look on a one-page and a two-page resume, A4 and Letter, then every look in the picker with each section style, density, font and size it offers and for printing and a pen: the page box unchanged, nothing overflows, grouped labels quiet and readable, no label louder than a job title, at most four marked labels a page

screens-check.covers: what the three places hold: the Library's cards and cards per row at 1280, 1920 and 2560, select then open, the inspector, Use for a new job (a company is required, typed text kept; the copy says from-parent in the name card, on a phone's name card and on its card), the inspector's overview table (sent facts first), Mark as sent… from the Library, Compare's bar beside the ticked cards, the growing page, the hover preview and its pages, the thumbnail cache, Compare with N and P, Career's docked entry with both scopes, search by a line, no bar, ten languages at three sizes

find-check.covers: the one search: Ctrl+F (Cmd+F) opens it and focuses its field in the Library, Editor, Career and Compare, the next press is the browser's, / is the fallback, plain F is a letter and full screen is F11 (typing f or F in ten writing surfaces toggles nothing; F11 works in a text box), Ctrl+Shift+F is untouched; its controls are pressable in the right tier

icon-check.covers: the icon design language: in Tea and Coffee, light and dark, on every screen and a phone, every rendered icon is a role size (12, 16, 24, 44) drawing the drink's stroke token in screen pixels; every control of a registered concept (delete, close, edit, revert, lock, add, more, pin, focus, help, zoom) draws the registered icon, delete is the X; no icon serves two concepts; the places draw the drink's tabs; the Outline's sections have icons and hues of their own

button-check.covers: the button system (UX-6 sidebar round 2): contrast, every primary, secondary and destructive button with an edge or fill at 3:1 against its ground in Tea and Coffee, light and dark, on every sidebar view, the name window, the menus, the Library, Career, the dialogs and the toast, every button tiered, no tertiary shadow, the heavy shadow only on a primary, Sent only and Keep pressed

sidebar-check.covers: the sidebar (UX-6 sidebar session): fit, every text in the Edit views, Design, Export, Settings and the Library inspector at the narrowest width in ten languages at least 8 characters wide, none cut, no short button broken; ticks, every checkbox a themed square tick on the tertiary press in the four looks, labelled, Space ticks, no role=switch; depth, the --elev tokens in the four looks, the active place tab raised by more than colour with its words at 4.5:1, the open mode joining the panel, fields sunk, the name window a popover; switches, the ?switches review flag draws the old pill and changes nothing else; off, a job or a line switched off keeps its place, comes back there, round a reorder and through the saved file; tiers, every control's tier or own look and its layer per view as recorded in fixtures/sidebar-tiers.json, at most one primary a view; width, the handle by pointer and keys, its own width again, Ctrl+\ and the chevron fold to the rail, remembered, the page x unmoved by selection at 316 and 640, themed, off on a phone; forms, the section heading box and a language name box still change what prints

label-fit.covers: every language's resume headings fit the gutter; the app's labels fit the sidebar's narrowest width (316px)

garden-check.covers: the tea garden in Chromium (about two minutes)
